sections.title: Content
sections.text: An API object that represents the job scheduler settings in the cluster. | Name | Type/Value | Description | |------|------------|-------------| | backup_job_settings | [backup_job_settings](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/job_scheduler/backup_job_settings) object | Backup job settings | | bdb_usage_report_job_settings | [bdb_usage_report_job_settings](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/job_scheduler/bdb_usage_report_job_settings) object | Job settings for database usage reports | | cert_rotation_job_settings | [cert_rotation_job_settings](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/job_scheduler/cert_rotation_job_settings) object | Job settings for internal certificate rotation | | granular_metrics_job_settings | [granular_metrics_job_settings](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/job_scheduler/granular_metrics_job_settings) object | Job settings for granular metrics collection | | log_rotation_job_settings | [log_rotation_job_settings](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/job_scheduler/log_rotation_job_settings) object | Log rotation job settings | | node_checks_job_settings | [node_checks_job_settings](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/job_scheduler/node_checks_job_settings) object | Node checks job settings | | redis_cleanup_job_settings | [redis_cleanup_job_settings](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/job_scheduler/redis_cleanup_job_settings) object | Redis cleanup job settings (deprecated as of Redis Software v6.4.2, replaced with persistence_cleanup_scan_interval) | | rotate_ccs_job_settings | [rotate_ccs_job_settings](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/job_scheduler/rotate_ccs_job_settings) object | Rotate CCS job settings |
